Context: Procedural requirements for easy settlement of claims

- If you draw an advance, you must produce the tickets within ten
- (v) days of drawal of advance.
- (vi)
- Government employees entitled to travel by air and not entitled to travel by air may travel by any airlines but reimbursement will be restricted to the fare of the entitled class or actuals, whichever is less.
- Booking of air tickets is to be done through approved travel
- (vii) agencies only.
